name: storage
label: Storage
description: Read and write plugin data, files, and database records

name: secrets
label: Secrets
description: Store and read this plugin's own passwords and keys in your system keychain

name: sessions
label: Sessions
description: Create and manage Claude Code sessions. It can also run them in the background, where they do not show in your session list, up to 20 a day.

name: ai
label: AI
description: Generate AI responses using your account's API quota

name: ai.subscription
label: AI on your Claude plan
description: Lets this plugin use your Claude plan for text generation, even when you have a saved API key. When this plugin uses your Claude plan, requests count toward that plan's usage limits.

name: ai.images
label: Make Pictures
description: Ask to make pictures with Image Studio, paid from your Omniscio credit. You confirm the price of every picture, and it has its own daily spending limit.

name: tts
label: Text to Speech
description: Read text aloud using your configured voice

name: stt
label: Speech to Text
description: Send recordings to your configured speech service to be turned into text

name: microphone
label: Microphone
description: Record from your microphone at any time while the plugin is open

name: network
label: Network
description: Make HTTP requests to external services

name: network.upload
label: Upload Files
description: Upload files from folders you choose for it to the websites it lists. You approve those websites the first time it uploads.

name: cron
label: Cron
description: Schedule recurring background tasks

name: cli
label: CLI Endpoints
description: Register CLI endpoints accessible from external tools

name: notifications
label: Notifications
description: Show toasts and system notifications

name: system
label: System
description: Run approved programs through this app's own launcher, read and replace the clipboard, and open files

name: rss
label: RSS
description: Read RSS feeds and your curated feed entries

name: auth
label: Identity & Sign-In
description: See who is signed in to Omniscio (your name and email), and get a sign-in key that lets it act as you in the app's shared cloud services - it can read and send anything you can, including your private channels and direct messages.

name: auth.session
label: Account Access
description: Request scoped access tokens for Google and GitHub on your behalf.

name: auth.sharedSignIn
label: Shared Sign-In
description: Share one sign-in session with the other plugins you allow this for, so you only sign in once instead of once per plugin. Those plugins can also see each other’s saved sign-in data.

name: auth.actAsUser
label: Act As You
description: Sign in to ONE shared service as you — Team Chat or the shared spreadsheet — for as long as that sign-in lasts, and only within that service: read and send messages in your Team Chat channels and direct messages, change who is in them, or work in a shared spreadsheet. Every server refuses that sign-in for anything else, so it cannot reach your other data. It is still a real sign-in to your account, so it can change your sign-in details or close the account. Only allow this for a plugin you would trust with your account.

name: sessions.readHistory
label: Session History
description: Read the full text of past Omniscio sessions and projects you grant it

name: sessions.images
label: Session Images
description: Send pictures to its own AI sessions so the AI can look at them. Those sessions cannot use any tools.

name: boards.read
label: Boards
description: Read the full contents of boards you grant it, including every item, column value and status

name: boards.link
label: Attach to your tasks
description: Attach and detach this plugin's own content on tasks you have granted it, without changing the tasks themselves

name: boards.write
label: Change boards
description: Add, move and update items and post comments on the boards you choose. Assigning a person or commenting asks you first.

name: tasks.read
label: Tasks
description: Read the task lists you choose, including their tasks, due dates and status.

name: tasks.write
label: Change tasks
description: Add, edit, complete, move, archive and restore tasks in the task lists you choose. Deleting a task asks you first.

name: sessions.launchAny
label: Launch Any Session
description: Start sessions in any of your projects, with any model or engine. Granted only to built-in plugins and to first-party plugins the Marketplace has classified.

name: sessions.observeStatus
label: Session Activity
description: See when your sessions start, finish, or need you. It never sees their text.

name: sessions.control
label: Manage your sessions
description: Send a message to, pause, unpause, snooze, archive and unarchive the sessions and projects you choose. It never sees what they say. It asks you first before messaging, pausing, archiving or reopening one, unless you turn that off in Settings.

name: vault.read
label: Vault notes
description: Read the Vault folders you choose.

name: vault.write
label: Change Vault notes
description: Change notes in the Vault folders you choose. Deleting asks you first.

name: calendar.read
label: Calendars
description: Read events, guests and meeting links on the calendars you choose.

name: timeTracker.read
label: Time Tracker
description: Read the projects, clients and recorded rates in your Time Tracker.

name: timeTracker.write
label: Create Time Tracker invoices and clients
description: Create a fixed-price invoice from the figures this plugin sends, and find or add a client. Rates are a suggestion and never set a price.

name: storageBackup.read
label: Plugin backup
description: Backs up this plugin's data off your computer, encrypted.

name: calendar.write
label: Change calendar events
description: Change events on the calendars you choose. Inviting people or deleting asks you first.

name: teamChat.read
label: Team Chat
description: Read the Team Chat channels and direct messages you pick, and search inside them.

name: teamChat.write
label: Post in Team Chat
description: Post, reply, react and send direct messages in the channels you pick, after you approve each one.

name: inbox
label: Inbox
description: Add items to your Omniscio inbox.

name: inbox.read
label: Inbox
description: See the titles of your open inbox items and sessions waiting on you, never their contents.

name: navigation
label: Navigation
description: Navigate Omniscio to your sessions, projects, and views

name: chrome
label: Interface
description: Add buttons and menu items to Omniscio

name: chrome.widget
label: Header Widget
description: Show a live status widget in the Omniscio header: a number, a short label, and a status color, which it can update at any time

name: launch
label: Launch
description: Open links and files, and run programs you confirm

name: mediaKeys
label: Media Keys
description: Press play, pause, next and previous for whatever music or video is playing on this computer

name: firebase
label: Firebase
description: List your signed-in Firebase accounts and projects, and start a Firebase login

name: recording
label: Screen Recording
description: Start and stop screen recordings, with your confirmation each time

name: spend
label: AI Spend
description: Read your AI cost and usage totals across all your accounts, so it can show you spend reports.

name: coreRead
label: Core Read
description: Read your sessions, projects, and the text of their messages (never their secrets)

name: oauth
label: Third-Party Sign-in
description: Sign you in to third-party services you choose to connect

name: channel
label: Live Connection
description: Maintain a live connection to an external service you choose

name: workspace.read
label: Workspace Files
description: Read files in the projects you grant it access to

name: workspace.write
label: Workspace Editing
description: Create, change, and delete files in the projects you grant it access to

name: workspace.exec
label: Workspace Commands
description: Run commands you approve, in the projects you grant it access to. Checking which files have changed (git status) is the one command it can run without asking.

name: documents.read
label: Read your documents
description: Open and search everything you have written in the app, and publish a document to a Google account you have connected

name: itemFolders
label: Item folders
description: Keep one folder per item in a folder named Omniscio (or Omniscio and a short code) in your home folder, holding a read-only copy of that item's files. The app writes that copy from its own record, so editing a file in the folder never changes the item.

name: print
label: Print labels
description: Print labels on the printers connected to this computer without a print window opening, and see which printers there are. It prints only what it sends, and no more than 30 labels a minute.

name: documents.write
label: Create, edit and delete your documents
description: Change or permanently remove anything you have written in the app, including restoring an older version over your current one

name: documents.convert
label: Turn a Word document into a PDF
description: Convert a Word document you picked into a PDF so it can be sent for signature, and tell you what in it needs a second look before it goes out. It never changes the original file.

name: members.read
label: See your workspace's people
description: Read the names, pictures and roles of the people in the workspace you are using. Never their email addresses.

name: members.manage
label: Add and remove your workspace's people
description: Invite people to the workspace you are using and remove people from it, only where you could do it yourself on the People screen, and only after you say yes in a confirmation dialog for each change.

name: people.read
label: People's schedules
description: See when the people in your workspace work and when they are away.

name: coaching-profile
label: Your Coaching Profile
description: Read the parts of your coaching profile you have chosen to share with it. It can never change them.

name: brands
label: Your Brands
description: Read the brands you accepted and propose changes for you to accept or reject. It can never accept one for you.

name: teamChat.emoji
label: Team Chat emoji
description: Offer custom emoji to Team Chat and see your workspace's custom emoji. You always confirm before anything is added.

name: email.send
label: Send Email
description: Send email from your Omniscio agent address to people it chooses, up to 500 a day. Every email has a one-click unsubscribe, and anyone who unsubscribed is never emailed again.

name: limits
label: Check its limits
description: Ask how much of its own daily allowance this plugin has left, so it can slow down before it is refused. It never sees your plan's limits or another plugin's usage, and the app's servers still count and enforce anything that costs money.

name: webassembly
label: WebAssembly
description: Run fast compiled code (WebAssembly) inside its own panel, for example to process video on your graphics card. It still cannot turn text into code.

name: email.fromName
label: Choose the sender name
description: Show a name of its choosing next to your Omniscio agent address on the email it sends, like "Weekly Digest". The address itself never changes, and the name can never be Omniscio.

name: live
label: Take part in live boards
description: Join the boards you have chosen to share live, so it can show what the other people are doing and add your edits. It cannot share a board or stop sharing one.

name: appCloner
label: Study apps in its own browser
description: Open websites in a separate browser of its own and study how their screens look and work. It never uses your own browser or its saved sign-ins, and it keeps a record of anything it changes on the site.
